info.title: FinVault Merchant API
info.description: Client API through Gateway. Frontend sends Bearer access tokens; Gateway signs ES256 x-gateway-token (60s). Services verify finvault-internal-auth claims. Internal authentication headers are never client inputs.

post.summary: Register a merchant for the signed-in owner

ownerId.description: Optional; for frontend callers must equal signed Auth ID. Normally omit.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

409.description: Duplicate resource, concurrent update or invalid transition

get.description: Returns data: null when no active merchant record exists. Database failures remain errors.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

get.summary: Read a merchant profile as owner/admin
get.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only. Soft-deleted merchants are treated as absent (404).

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

put.description: Changed profile and merchant.profile_updated Outbox are committed atomically. Identical values are a no-op. ownerId/status/version cannot be changed here.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

409.description: Duplicate resource, concurrent update or invalid transition

patch.description: ADMIN/internal only. Allowed transitions: PENDING→APPROVED/REJECTED, APPROVED→REJECTED, REJECTED→PENDING. Repeating the current status is a no-op with no version bump and no event. The status change and its merchant.status_updated Outbox row commit in one Serializable transaction.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

get.summary: Check whether a merchant is active
get.description: Any authenticated caller/internal. Returns minimal activity data only; tax ID and bank account are never included. active is true only for APPROVED.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

get.summary: List merchants (ADMIN only for frontend callers)

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

post.summary: Create an outlet for an APPROVED merchant
post.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only. The merchant must be APPROVED (409 MERCHANT_NOT_APPROVED). The outlet row, the Merchant version bump and the merchant.profile_updated Outbox row commit in one Serializable transaction. Outlet codes are globally unique (409 DUPLICATE_RESOURCE) because a scanned QR resolves an outlet without merchant context.

code.description: Globally unique. Restricted to letters, digits, hyphen and underscore because the QR canonical form is pipe-delimited.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

409.description: Merchant is not APPROVED, or the outlet code is already taken

get.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only. Always scoped by the merchantId in the path: an outletId belonging to another merchant is never returned.

schema.description: Case-insensitive substring match on name or code.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

get.summary: Read the signed QR payload for an outlet
get.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only, APPROVED merchant only. Returns an HMAC-SHA256 signature over the canonical pipe-delimited payload version|merchantId|outletId|outletCode|issuedAt, signed with the dedicated MERCHANT_QR_SECRET system secret (never a merchant API key). The outlet is resolved by both outletId and merchantId, so another merchant's outlet is 404. Responses carry Cache-Control: no-store.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

404.description: Merchant not found, or the outlet does not belong to this merchant

post.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only, APPROVED merchant only. The raw credential `<keyId>.<secret>` is returned exactly once in this response; only the SHA-256 of the secret is stored. Responses carry Cache-Control: no-store, and no endpoint ever returns the stored hash.

201.description: API key issued; the raw secret is present only here

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

delete.description: Owner/ADMIN/internal only. Idempotent: a repeated revoke returns the original revokedAt and never re-exposes the secret. A revoked key never authenticates. An unknown keyId for this merchant answers 404.

401.description: Missing/invalid access token at Gateway, or missing/invalid Gateway Token at service (INVALID_GATEWAY_TOKEN).

404.description: Merchant or API key not found

active.description: True only when status is APPROVED.

version.description: QR payload schema version; part of the signed canonical form.

issuedAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds; part of the signed canonical form.

prefix.description: Public 8-character display fragment; not usable as a credential.

key.description: Raw `<keyId>.<secret>` credential. Present only in this creation response; never stored or returned again.
